headline: W S Industries announces exit of independent director R. Karthik
summary: W S Industries (I) Limited has notified the stock exchange that Non-Executive Independent Director R. Karthik will cease to hold office effective October 31, 2026. This routine board composition change alters the company's governance structure ahead of the effective date. Retail investors tracking board continuity should note the upcoming vacancy. The departure involves a single non-executive role and carries no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no immediate financial impact on shareholders.
